name: Late Night Lethal, 21 May 2001

date.source: The show document's own dateline.

notes: The document's own byline reads "05.21.01", but its content (the Doctor's debut at a "Suicide" pay-per-view, the office holding owner David Beaumont hostage, Aaron Antioch's switch away from a religious gimmick) reads as later than that date — none of it fits comfortably before the Evo/Mercury split of 3 September 2001, and "Suicide" does not appear among the classic-era pay-per-views the Vault itself lists. No second document states a conflicting date, so the byline's own date stands per the standing rule that a document's own dateline is not silently overridden — this is flagged as an open dating anomaly, not resolved.
